## Your questions.Honest answers.

Everything you want to know before getting started. And remember when you start your plan, you will have access to learning tutorials & unlimited access to clinicians for virtual consults or support.

### What happens if I don't see results?

You're protected by our **Wellorithm Weight Loss Warranty.** If you follow your plan and don't reach your goal with us, you get a full refund.

_Your progress is measured and verified by licensed clinicians throughout your treatment. [Terms](https://wellorithm.com/terms-of-service) apply. Warranty is not applicable to Microdosing products._

### What's included with Wellorithm?

The Wellorithm program includes a prescription to GLP-1 medication (if qualified), unlimited video calls with clinicians, and a 4-week supply of medication every month. We have a simple all-inclusive pricing model with no hidden fees, no separate membership fees, and cost of medication all included in the price.

### What treatments do you offer?

At Wellorithm, we specialize in compounded GLP-1 medication programs, specifically Semaglutide and Tirzepatide. Licensed medical clinicians have developed medical protocols and clinicians prescribe compounded GLP-1s for achieving sustainable weight loss. All prescriptions are clinician-guided and may not be suitable for everyone. Your clinician will determine the right medication and starting dosage for you.

### How does it work?

Getting started with Wellorithm is simple and designed around fast, reliable care:

1\. Complete Your Intake – Start with a short online health questionnaire so our licensed clinicians can review your medical history and weight loss goals.

2\. Meet With a Clinician – Connect 1:1 with a clinician through a virtual visit. They'll confirm whether compounded Semaglutide or Tirzepatide is right for you and create your personalized treatment plan.

3\. Fast Medication Delivery – Once prescribed, your medication is prepared by our compounding pharmacy and shipped to your door within 72 hours, in discreet packaging.

4\. Always-On Support – You'll have access to our U.S.-based care team 7 days a week for any questions, side effect guidance, or dosage adjustments.

5\. Wellorithm Weight Loss Warranty – if you don't achieve your Wellorithm weight loss goal in 12 months, you get your money back guaranteed. Plus, you'll never face medication shortages—we guarantee continuous supply.

### What states do you serve?

Wellorithm is available in 49 U.S. states. At this time, we're unable to provide services in Louisiana or outside the United States. Every prescription is reviewed and managed by our licensed clinicians, so you can access safe, effective treatment no matter where you live within our service area.

### What can I expect after I sign up?

Once you complete the health intake quiz, a licensed clinician will review your information. If you are prescribed medication, after your prescription is processed, you will receive tracking information via text and email. Each shipment includes a four-week supply of medication. You'll have ongoing access to our care team and clinicians for any questions or support. To ensure a continuous supply, please complete the refill form after taking the third dose of your prescription. If you have questions about progress, side effects, or dosage, you can consult with a clinician at no extra cost.

### Do you require insurance?

No insurance required, and no hidden fees. We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, along with HSA/FSA.

### What is the cancellation and refund policy?

The program operates on a month-to-month basis with no minimum commitments or contracts, allowing for flexible and easy cancellation. You may cancel your subscription at any time. To cancel your plan, simply log into your portal and select 'Cancel Plan' on the Profile page. Once your payment has been processed, you are no longer eligible for a refund. If the clinician determines you are not eligible after you first enroll in the program, we will refund 100% of your initial payment.

### I have a previous prescription from another weight-loss company, can I start at a higher dosage?

If you have an existing prescription from another weight-loss clinician, a clinician may determine that it is appropriate to begin your treatment at a dosage equivalent to your previous prescription—provided it has been no more than two weeks since your last injection. Please upload documentation of your previous prescription to your portal and schedule an appointment with a clinician to review and confirm the appropriate starting dosage.

### How do I know I'll get support if something goes wrong?

You're never on your own with Wellorithm. Our 250+ U.S.-based care agents are available every day of the week to answer questions about dosage, side effects, or anything else that comes up. And if you ever need a clinician, you can book a 1:1 virtual appointment right away—often same-day, no insurance required.

### This feels expensive. What makes Wellorithm worth it?

Wellorithm offers predictable, transparent pricing with no hidden fees so you always know exactly what you're paying. We negotiate directly with U.S. pharmacies to keep medication affordable, saving patients up to 40% compared to alternative programs. But the greatest return on investment is your health. Wellorithm helps you achieve sustainable weight loss, reduce the risk of chronic conditions, and enjoy a higher quality of life.

### Is Wellorithm as legitimate as seeing a local clinician?

Yes. With Wellorithm, you're seeing the same caliber of licensed, U.S. clinician you'd meet in person, only in a more convenient telehealth setting. Every clinician is U.S.-licensed, so you can feel confident knowing your care is real and provided by trusted U.S. clinicians.

### How fast will I see results?

Results vary by person, but most Wellorithm members notice progress within the first month. On average, men lose over 7 pounds and women lose over 5 pounds in the first 30 days. By 90 days, members typically lose more than 14 pounds, with some reporting over 20 pounds. Results continue to build over time, leading to steady, sustainable weight loss with consistent use of the program. Based on self-reported data from approximately 103,735 Wellorithm members on a personalized treatment plan.

### I'm nervous about injections. What should I expect?

We understand that many people feel uneasy about needles. We provide clear instructions and training resources so you'll feel confident from your very first dose.

FAQ

### What is Wegovy®?

Wegovy® (semaglutide) is an FDA-approved prescription medication used for chronic weight management in adults with obesity or excess weight. It belongs to a class of medications called GLP-1 receptor agonists.

Wegovy® works by mimicking a natural hormone in your body that helps regulate appetite and blood sugar, which can support reduced food intake and healthier eating patterns when combined with lifestyle changes.

FAQ

### How effective is Wegovy® for weight loss?

Wegovy® has been clinically studied for weight management. In clinical trials, adults who used Wegovy® alongside diet and lifestyle changes lost an average of 14–15% of their body weight over one year.\*

Individual results vary based on factors such as dosage, adherence, lifestyle habits, and overall health.

FAQ

### What is the Wegovy® pill, and how is it different from the Wegovy® pen?

Both the Wegovy® pill and the Wegovy® pen contain the same active ingredient, semaglutide, and are FDA-approved for weight management. The main difference is how and how often they’re taken.

Similarities:

- Both are FDA-approved Wegovy® formulations
- Both use semaglutide as the active ingredient
- Both follow a gradual dose-increase schedule determined by a provider
- Side effects are generally similar and can be managed with provider support

Differences:

- Wegovy® pen: Taken as a once-weekly injection
- Wegovy® pill: Taken orally once per day

Your Shed provider will help determine which option may be appropriate based on your health history, preferences, and treatment goals.

FAQ

### What’s the difference between Ozempic® and Wegovy®?

Both medications contain semaglutide, but they are FDA-approved for different uses.

- Ozempic® is approved to treat type 2 diabetes
- Wegovy® is specifically approved for chronic weight management

In some cases, providers may prescribe Ozempic® off-label for weight management when appropriate, but Wegovy® is the formulation designed and approved for weight loss.

## Questions? We’ve got answers.

Health

### What is Wegovy®?

Wegovy® (semaglutide) is an FDA-approved prescription medication used for chronic weight management in adults with obesity or excess weight. It belongs to a class of medications called GLP-1 receptor agonists.

Wegovy® works by mimicking a natural hormone in your body that helps regulate appetite and blood sugar, which can support reduced food intake and healthier eating patterns when combined with lifestyle changes.

‍

Health

### How effective is Wegovy® for weight loss?

Wegovy® has been clinically studied for weight management. In clinical trials, adults who used Wegovy® alongside diet and lifestyle changes lost an average of 14–15% of their body weight over one year.\*

Individual results vary based on factors such as dosage, adherence, lifestyle habits, and overall health.

Health

### What is the Wegovy® pill, and how is it different from the Wegovy® pen?

Both the Wegovy® pill and the Wegovy® pen contain the same active ingredient, semaglutide, and are FDA-approved for weight management. The main difference is how and how often they’re taken.Similarities:

- Both are FDA-approved Wegovy® formulations
- Both use semaglutide as the active ingredient
- Both follow a gradual dose-increase schedule determined by a provider
- Side effects are generally similar and can be managed with provider support

Differences:

- Wegovy® pen: Taken as a once-weekly injection
- Wegovy® pill: Taken orally once per day

Your Shed provider will help determine which option may be appropriate based on your health history, preferences, and treatment goals.

Health

### What’s the difference between Ozempic® and Wegovy®?

Both medications contain semaglutide, but they are FDA-approved for different uses.

- Ozempic® is approved to treat type 2 diabetes
- Wegovy® is specifically approved for chronic weight management

In some cases, providers may prescribe Ozempic® off-label for weight management when appropriate, but Wegovy® is the formulation designed and approved for weight loss.

Health

### How does Shed’s Wegovy® program work?

Shed provides access to Wegovy® through a fully online, provider-led care model.

If prescribed, your program includes:

- A medical review by a licensed provider
- Ongoing provider support and follow-ups
- Text-based Health Coaching\*\*

- A supportive community to help you stay on track

Medication costs are separate from the monthly Shed membership.

Wegovy® is not appropriate for everyone. A licensed healthcare provider will review your health history and goals to determine whether Wegovy® may be a safe and suitable option for you.

### What is Wegovy® and how does it work?

Wegovy® is a once-weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist designed to mimic a natural hormone that helps regulate appetite and food intake. It signals the brain to reduce hunger and slow down digestion, which helps patients feel fuller for longer.

Health

### What kind of results can I expect on Wegovy®?

Most patients begin seeing meaningful weight loss within the first few weeks, especially when paired with lifestyle changes. Clinical trials showed average weight loss of up to 15% of total body weight over 68 weeks.

Health

### What’s the difference between Ozempic® and Wegovy®?

Both contain semaglutide, but Ozempic® is FDA-approved for Type 2 diabetes management, while Wegovy® is specifically approved for weight loss. That said, many providers prescribe Ozempic® off-label for weight management when appropriate.

Health

### How do I take Wegovy®?

It’s a simple subcutaneous injection taken once a week. It can be administered in the stomach, thigh, or upper arm—whatever’s most comfortable for you.

Health

### Are there any side effects of Wegovy®?

The most common side effects are gastrointestinal—things like nausea, constipation, or mild bloating. These are usually temporary and improve as your body adjusts.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Oral Semaglutide?

Oral Semaglutide is a compounded buccal lozenge containing Semaglutide, a GLP-1 receptor agonist used for medically supervised weight management. It dissolves between the cheek and gum, so no injections are required.

How do I take Oral Semaglutide lozenges?

Place the lozenge between your cheek and gum and allow it to dissolve fully, as directed by your doctor. Most patients take one lozenge per day at the same time.

How does Semaglutide reduce appetite?

Semaglutide mimics the GLP-1 hormone your body makes naturally. It signals the brain regarding satiety, slows how quickly food leaves the stomach, and may help increase insulin release, together helping reduce hunger throughout the day.\*

What results can I expect?

Results vary by individual and depend on your starting point, dose, and lifestyle habits. Many patients see progress over a 3 to 12 month plan when Semaglutide is paired with healthy nutrition and movement.\*

How does Oral Semaglutide compare to the injectable?

Both formats contain Semaglutide and are prescribed for the same purpose. The oral lozenge dissolves between the cheek and gum once daily with no needles, while the injectable is a once-weekly subcutaneous shot. Injectable Semaglutide may offer slightly higher bioavailability, but the lozenge is a needle-free alternative for patients who want to avoid injections.

How long do I need to stay on Semaglutide?

Treatment length is personalized with your physician and depends on your goals. Many patients continue on a maintenance dose to help sustain results after their initial phase.

Is Semaglutide safe for long-term use?

Semaglutide is intended for medically supervised, ongoing use, with your physician monitoring your progress and adjusting your plan as needed. Share your full medical history so your provider can confirm it's appropriate for long-term use in your case.

Do I need to change my diet?

Semaglutide works alongside healthy nutrition and regular movement; it isn't a replacement for lifestyle changes. Your physician can help you build a plan that fits your routine.

How long until I see results?

Many patients notice appetite changes within the first weeks, with progress occurring over 3 to 12 months when paired with healthy nutrition and movement.\*

How much does the online visit cost?

The initial online consultation is included with your subscription. You only pay for the medication if a Strut physician determines treatment is appropriate.

Is shipping free?

Yes. Your monthly price includes free shipping along with the medication and physician consultations, with no hidden fees.

Is medical necessity required for compounded Semaglutide?

Yes. Compounded Oral Semaglutide is intended for use only when a clinical need cannot be met by an FDA-approved product. A Strut physician reviews your information to confirm compounded treatment is appropriate before it's prescribed.

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about GLP-1 + GIP Advanced

### What makes GLP-1 Advanced different from GLP-1 Core?

GLP-1 Advanced uses compounded tirzepatide, which combines both GLP-1 and GIP receptor activation for enhanced metabolic benefits. While GLP-1 Core focuses on single receptor activation, compounded tirzepatide adds GIP support for broader insulin signaling and appetite regulation. This makes GLP-1 Advanced a strong option for patients who need greater appetite suppression or have plateaued on single-receptor GLP-1 medications.

### How quickly will I see results with GLP-1 Advanced?

Most patients begin to notice early changes within 2–4 weeks, with more significant weight loss commonly occurring within the first 3 months. Because tirzepatide targets both GLP-1 and GIP receptors, many patients experience faster and more consistent progress compared to single-receptor GLP-1 options.

### What are the common side effects of tirzepatide?

Common side effects may include nausea, decreased appetite, or mild gastrointestinal discomfort, especially during dose increases. These effects often improve as the body adjusts. Your provider will monitor your response and can adjust your tirzepatide dosage to support comfort and long-term success.

### How do I know if GLP-1 Advanced is right for me?

Compounded tirzepatide may be appropriate for patients seeking stronger appetite control, improved glucose regulation, or additional support after limited results with other GLP-1 medications. A licensed provider will review your health history, goals, and lab results to determine whether a tirzepatide prescription is the right fit for you.

### What’s included when I purchase GLP-1 Advanced?

Your subscription includes 4 weeks of compounded tirzepatide medication, ongoing provider care and support, metabolic lab testing every 6 months, essential supplies (syringes and alcohol pads), wellness coaching, and full platform access with educational content.

### How do I inject my GLP-1 medication?

GLP-1 medications are administered as a subcutaneous injection, meaning the medication is injected just beneath the skin—not into muscle or vein. Most patients find the process simple and well-tolerated after their first few doses.

To ensure proper technique, safety, and comfort, we strongly recommend watching our step-by-step injection video, which walks through preparation, injection, and disposal in detail.
